title: 2406. Divide Intervals Into Minimum Number of Groups

examples.explanation: We can divide the intervals into the following groups: - Group 1: [1, 5], [6, 8]. - Group 2: [2, 3], [5, 10]. - Group 3: [1, 10]. It can be proven that it is not possible to divide the intervals into fewer than 3 groups.
None of the intervals overlap, so we can put all of them in one group.
